title: Question tags
note: Positive sentence -> negative tag and the reverse; the tag repeats the auxiliary. Czech has one invariant tag (ze jo? / vid? / ze ne?) so students produce *You are coming, no? and *You like it, yes?. Where the sentence has no auxiliary, the tag supplies do/does/did. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: Question tags
points: Czech uses one little tag for everything. English changes it to match the sentence.

cards.title: The tag copies the auxiliary
points: Find the auxiliary in the sentence and reuse it.

cards.title: When there is no auxiliary
points: The tag brings in **do /** does / did, just as a question would.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: The tag flips the sentence: positive to negative, negative to positive.

items.explanation: Positive sentence with **are**, so a negative tag with the same verb: aren't you.
items.explanation_cz: Kladná věta s **are**, takže záporný dovětek se stejným slovesem: aren't you.

items.explanation: Negative sentence, so the tag is positive: **does she**.
items.explanation_cz: Záporná věta, takže dovětek je kladný: **does she**.

items.explanation: Past simple with no auxiliary, so the tag supplies **did**: didn't they.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý čas bez pomocného slovesa, takže dovětek dodá **did**: didn't they.

items.explanation: Present simple with **you**, so the tag is **don't you**.
items.explanation_cz: Přítomný prostý s **you**, takže dovětek je **don't you**.

items.explanation: Third person present simple, so **doesn't he**.
items.explanation_cz: Třetí osoba přítomného prostého, takže **doesn't he**.

items.en: She has left already, hasn't she?
accepts: She has left already, hasn't she?
items.explanation: The auxiliary is **has**, so the tag reuses it: hasn't she.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné sloveso je **has**, takže ho dovětek zopakuje: hasn't she.

items.explanation: **can** is the auxiliary, so the negative tag is can't they.
items.explanation_cz: **can** je pomocné sloveso, takže záporný dovětek je can't they.

items.en: It isn't very expensive, is it?
items.cz: Není to moc drahé, že ne?
accepts: It isn't very expensive, is it?
items.wrong: It isn't very expensive, isn't it?
items.explanation: Negative sentence takes a positive tag: **is it**.
items.explanation_cz: Záporná věta má kladný dovětek: **is it**.

items.en: You didn't call her, did you?
accepts: You didn't call her, did you?
items.explanation: Negative past, so a positive tag with **did**.
items.explanation_cz: Záporná minulost, takže kladný dovětek s **did**.

items.explanation: **we're** is we are, so the tag is aren't we.
items.explanation_cz: **we're** je we are, takže dovětek je aren't we.
